_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit to match your org's tools. config.json is gitignored.

_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_DATABASE_URL: Optional. PostgreSQL connection URL for hosted-service mode; SQLite is used when unset.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_WRITE_TOKEN: Optional for local use. When configured, required for FastAPI POST/PATCH endpoints.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_CORS_ORIGINS: Comma-separated origins; defaults to * for local use.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_BASE_URL: Hosted base URL used for OAuth callbacks.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_APP_SESSION_SECRET: Secret used to sign hosted OAuth state.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_KMS_KEY_NAME: Full Cloud KMS key resource name used to encrypt hosted Google credentials.
_environment.DRIVE_ANALYTICS_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_CONF: Hosted OAuth client JSON, usually provided from Secret Manager.
Alternative path to hosted OAuth client JSON.
